title: A green task gate stands for the fix leg, so the red-first proof runs once
description: Probe probe-8bf7e194: the proof ran a second time (~114 s per task) after a green task gate. Two causes in the record: the held gate run is a repeat (background gate read back), and gate_binding reads its copied row without following reusedFrom, so no background task gate can stand for the fix leg; and the joined sweep step keeps only a digest of its command, so it is spelled otherwise. Plus a bare sweep's per-file counts are cut at MAX_PATHS before the proof's file. Design: quality-gates-internal PLAN, probe-8bf7e194 and F933.
desiredOutcome: On a task whose green gate ran the proof's test file - as a repeated verdict, inside a joined step with the affected suites, or under the bare recorded sweep - the drive binds the fix leg to that run instead of running the proof's fix leg again, never where the helper's own fix leg would say red; and the gate's own record says which files its time went to.

tasks.title: The fix leg binds through a repeated gate verdict to the run that measured it
tasks.description: gate_binding reads the gated mark's row through ledger_row -> proof_steps(row) and never follows reusedFrom; a background task gate is read back as a repeat (verdictSource reused, no steps), so no background task gate - every gate here - ever stands for the fix leg (probe k15t/k32t: held 00:12:47Z.611642, a repeat of measured d7e1df). Fix: resolve the held row with _evio.measured_row(rows, row) as held_green_moved does; read steps and coverage off the measured row; both rows passed; a source not in the ledger refuses ('a repeat whose source is gone names no tree'); a step carrying STEP_REUSED_KEY on a part-reused row stays refused; add an explicit check that the measured row's testedState.head equals the proof's head (_evio.same_head). fixLegRunId names the measured run; the clause names both ids. Rewrite gate_binding's docstring. Dependants: file_writer_return (writes the run id), _filed_returns.fix_leg_problem and its basis text (unchanged files - read them), held_green_moved, tests fbg*/fbm*. Names: avoid _drift/_violations/_problems.

tasks.title: A joined or bare sweep step stands for the fix leg on the proof file's own printed count
tasks.description: proof_steps matches only command == proof or digest equality, so the joined task-gate step (name '<proof cmd> + affected/related: ...', only commandSha256 kept) is 'spelled otherwise' though _evio.step_parts(name)[0] is the proof command. Make proof_steps return (step, shape): exact (today's rule, totals check unchanged), joined (step_parts head == proof command, derived part non-empty), bare (declared step whose verbatim command satisfies _affected.is_bare_entry(command, phase, meta) and _affected.entry_paths(proof_cmd, phase, meta) is not None). For joined and bare, step_standing requires per-file counts with NO files==1 shortcut: for each path p the proof hands the spelling (entry_paths, agreeing with testDigest paths) the step's sweep_file_cases holds p with count >= redFiles[p] when red; redFiles empty and one path -> count >= owes.collected; redFiles empty and several paths -> refuse; a green proof file must still be present with a printed count. Paths compared under ONE key, sweep_path_key(p) = backslashes to '/', leading './' stripped, exact equality (no suffix matching - it aliases a/test_x.py and b/test_x.py). Exit 0, no outcome, not muted, not reused, coverage names every proof file - as now. Update the gate_binding / step_standing docstrings, the guide section and execute-task.md where they say a narrowed or otherwise-spelled step binds nothing. Depends on the repeat fix (task 1). Names: avoid _drift/_violations/_problems.

tasks.title: A sweep's recorded per-file counts keep the task's declared test files past the cut
tasks.description: _evidence_io.sweep_cases sorts files by path and cuts at MAX_PATHS (40): a full sweep keeps .claude/hooks and plugins/audit/hooks first, so a task's own test file is almost always cut and the drive refuses the step as 'printed no count'. Add sweep_cases(text, keep=()) putting paths in keep (compared under one '/'-normalising key, leading './' stripped) first, sorted, then the rest sorted, then the cut; filesDropped as now. run-test-gate.py passes the task's declared test files when the run is task-scoped. Invariant: a declared test file the sweep printed a count for is never cut while fewer than MAX_PATHS declared files exist. Dependants: sweep_file_cases readers in drive-phase (unchanged), RECORD_CUT_ORDER (does not cover sweepCases). If task P174.2 introduces a shared path key, this task may run first: define the key in _evidence_io and have drive-phase reuse it later.
